title: Sausage Flowers
description: For this sausage flowers recipe, cups are made from wonton wrappers, filled with cheese and sausage, baked and topped with sour cream and green onions.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a mini muffin tin.
Cook sausage in a large, deep skillet over medium-high heat until evenly browned; drain and remove from heat.
Stir Monterey Jack cheese and Colby cheese into warm sausage until melted; stir in salsa.
Gently press wonton wrappers into the prepared tin so edges are extending. Place a heaping 1 tablespoon sausage mixture into each wrapper.
Bake in the preheated oven until wonton edges begin to brown, about 10 minutes.
Transfer sausage flowers to a serving platter; dollop each with about 1 tablespoon sour cream. Sprinkle with green onions.

video.description: Meat and cheese in a crispy shell . . . what’s not to love? These indulgent appetizers are also simple to make, and will be a hit at your next party; expect several requests for the recipe! Begin by cooking Italian sausage until browned and juicy, then stir in Monterey Jack and Colby cheeses along with salsa. Press wonton wrappers into a mini muffin pan, fill to heaping with the savory filling and bake until wonton cups are crispy. Top with sour cream and green onions and watch them disappear!
